description: Seonho Park publishes PyOPF, a Python implementation of optimal-power-flow models. The March 2023 Zenodo release archives version 0.2.0 and states that both AC and DC formulations are finalised, primal and dual variables can warm-start a solution, and solving is exposed through a function. The software archive is publicly available under MIT at no cost. Application geography, time horizon, input-file conventions and solver requirements are not specified in the deposited description. PyOPF can support comparisons of operating-cost and network-constraint solutions once those interfaces are checked. The GitHub address linked by the deposit returned HTTP 404 through the authenticated API; Zenodo's own page and archive inventory remain accessible. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Neither the archived code nor numerical results were downloaded or executed, so current maintenance and solver compatibility remain unknown.
